item.title: Multimodal spatial transcriptomics redefines cortical pathology in Huntington's disease.
item.description:
Worth reading · Cell · section: Omics & Datasets · topic is in the title · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Omics & Datasets definition: strong · published this week
Imaging 428,173 cells in the control and HD cortex revealed the selective vulnerability of layer 5-6 (L5-6) near-projecting (NP) neurons and L6b deep-layer excitatory neurons, which undergo a >50% loss that is closely linked to large somatic repeat expansions (>450 ± 55 CAGs).

item.title: The amygdaloid complex: from morphology to neurodegeneration.
item.description:
Worth reading · Brain : a journal of neurology · section: Omics & Datasets · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Omics & Datasets definition: moderate · published this week
In summary, the amygdala acts as a densely connected hub with a broad role not only in physiological and psychological health but also in disease states; indeed, the amygdala is affected early in several neurodegenerative disorders, and in some (notably limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy and argyrophilic grain disease) it is among the first regions in which pathology is detected.
